raw_html: [[Shielded by Moonlight]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Shielded by Moonlight]]:''' Being struck in melee has a small chance to return some lost [[Hit point|Hitpoints]] and [[Spell point|Spellpoints]] to you. Offensive spells have a chance to grant 100 temporary spellpoints. This has a one minute cooldown.
